title: Sky Watcher operators differ from legacy programs

tellings.quote: Granted, this is not what Jake's team does. The operators he has on this team do not do what may these legacy programs do. It's completely different.

plain: The armed operators on a team called Sky Watcher, led by a man named Jake Barber, are said to do something completely different from the long-running secret government efforts that people in this field call legacy programmes. Michael Herrera, who says he saw a craft 300 feet across in the Indonesian jungle, tells Michels this as he heard it from Barber: "The operators he has on this team do not do what these legacy programs do." If true, Barber's group would be something separate from those older secret efforts, not a continuation of them.
